name: Orange Hawkweed
desc: Orange Hawkweed (Pilosella aurantiaca): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pilosella aurantiaca (fox-and-cubs, orange hawkweed, devil's paintbrush, and historically grim-the-collier) is a perennial flowering plant in the family Asteraceae.
